allowed_actions: inspect retained runner artifacts and draft wrapper contracts
forbidden_actions: run llm-r2 / generate sql / execute databases
expected_outputs: runner recovery contract and retained path map
stop_condition: stop if no stable runner entrypoint can be identified

allowed_actions: read retained substrate audits and draft substrate contract
expected_outputs: logical-plan substrate contract and blocker map
stop_condition: stop if retained failure modes cannot be generalized to a reusable route boundary

allowed_actions: inspect extraction audits and draft reusable extraction contract
forbidden_actions: generate model outputs / test new extraction outputs
expected_outputs: output-sql extraction contract and artifact schema
stop_condition: stop if extraction behavior cannot be generalized beyond one-case retained evidence

allowed_actions: enumerate reproducibility inputs and draft contract
forbidden_actions: rebuild indexes / stage new corpora / run retrieval
expected_outputs: reproducibility contract and human-provided prerequisites list
stop_condition: stop if retrieval or runtime identity cannot be made explicit from retained artifacts

allowed_actions: identify planning-only bounded pg overlap candidate set and package shape
forbidden_actions: run pg generation / claim mysql or spark readiness
expected_outputs: bounded pg overlap dry-run plan draft
stop_condition: stop if runner substrate extraction and reproducibility contracts are unresolved

allowed_actions: prepare review packet and summarize unresolved blockers
forbidden_actions: authorize generation implicitly / create executable run authorization
stop_condition: stop if human approval is not explicit
